title: Spicy Indian-Style Kidney Bean Salad with Cucumber, Tomato & Cilantro

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Juice limes into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, maple syrup, sesame seeds, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the beans. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide bean salad between bowls and enjoy!
